headline: 1996 executive order on "empowerment contracting," tied to how federal agencies award contracts to businesses in struggling communities.
what_it_does: This order deals with how the federal government awards contracts. The title suggests it aims to use federal buying to help businesses in economically distressed areas, or businesses that hire people from those areas. No summary was provided, so the exact rules, incentives, and requirements cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that buy goods and services
who_it_affects.how: They would likely be directed to consider new factors when awarding contracts.
They may get more chances to win federal contracts, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 21, 1996; the title alone does not state an effective date.
